# Draconic Ancestry (`traits:draconic-ancestry`)
**Species:** [Dragonborn](../species/dragonborn.md)

Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance traits as well as your appearance.
Draconic Ancestors
Dragon / Damage Type
Black / Acid
Blue / Lightning
Brass / Fire
Bronze / Lightning
Copper / Acid
Green / Poison
Gold / Fire
Red / Fire
Silver / Cold
White / Cold
